podcasts.name: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Admiration for Animals' Organ Sound
podcast.body: Graham Bond, a renowned Hammond organ player, was greatly impressed by The Animals' electric organ sound after hearing them perform at the Club a Go-Go, leading him to facilitate their London gigs. "soon Bond was raving back in London about this group from Newcastle he'd heard."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 115: "House of the Rising Sun" by the Animals

podcast.title: Origins from Alex Korner's Band
podcast.body: This group was formed by Graham Bond and other members who had departed from Alex Korner's band. "Bond and a few other members of the corner group had quit, and had formed their own group, the Graham Bond organisation"
